quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: GE Vernova establishes VSC-HVDC joint venture with LS (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GE Vernova signed an agreement to establish a joint venture with LS Electric to strengthen its competitiveness in the Voltage-Sourced Converter (VSC) HVDC business, described as a core component of Korea's next-generation power grid. No terms stated.
